The structure of Lu8Mg4Cd4 (reduced formula Lu2MgCd) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: Cd and Mg centers have 12 geometric neighbors, while Lu centers have 12 neighbors (4 Cd, 2 Mg, 6 Lu). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Lu–Lu 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Cd–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners and edges.
